feeding_claim.verbatim: hormone-free lightly grain fed Black Angus beef

resold_note: Also sells grass-fed beef, grass-fed bison, heritage pork, free-range chicken and wild-caught seafood from a partner group of farmers in Illinois and Missouri, under the name Barn Again Meats.
notes: Farm just outside Princeville, Peoria area. The site is a single page (no separate about, shop, FAQ or delivery pages exist). The farm's own Black Angus is described as lightly grain fed, so the category is grain-finished; the grass-fed beef and bison are bought from partner farms and are not counted. Buyers call the farm and some cuts are kept in freezers; quarter, half and whole beef orders are taken for spring locker dates. No phone number is printed on the site even though it says to call, and product prices are marked as being updated. Pickup channel is inferred from the freezer stock; no delivery or shipping is stated.
